messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Kaj vi vidos tiujn, kiuj estas kontentaj en la fajro ĉar ili esperas veni kiam ajn ĝi estu al la benitaj homoj.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | e | coordinating conjunction “and then” | **Kaj** | “and” (introducing the next clause) | OK | | vederai | future 2nd sg. of *vedere* – “you will see” | **vi vidos** | “you will see” | OK | | color | demonstrative pronoun plural – “those” | **tiujn** | “those (people)” | OK | | che (rel.) | relative pronoun – “who” | **kiuj** | “who” | OK | | son | present of *essere* – “are” | **estas** | “are” | OK | | contenti | predicative adjective – “contented” | **kontentaj** | “contented” | OK | | nel | preposition *in* + article – “in the” | **en** | “in” | OK | | foco | noun “fire” | **fajro** | “fire” | OK | | perché | causal conjunction – “because” | **ĉar** | “because” | OK | | speran | present 3rd pl. of *sperare* – “they hope” | **ili esperas** | “they hope” | OK | | di | preposition introducing infinitive – “to” (infinitive marker) | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | venire | infinitive of *venire* – “to come” | **veni** | “to come” | OK | | quando | temporal adverb/conjunction – “whenever” | **kiam** | “when” | OK | | che (idiom) | particle in *quando che* – no lexical meaning, reinforces temporality | **ajn** | “any” (as in “whenever”) | OK | | sia | present subjunctive of *essere* – “it may be” | **ĝi estu** | “it may be” | OK | | a | preposition “to” (direction) | **al** | “to” | OK | | le | definite article, fem. plural – “the” | **la** | “the” | OK | | beate | predicative adjective – “blessed” | **benitaj** | “blessed” | OK | | genti | noun fem. plural – “folk/people” | **homoj** | “people” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *di* – the infinitive marker is not expressed in Esperanto and is therefore omitted. No other source words are missing or incorrectly rendered, and no grammatical agreement errors were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
